Name: BFAV Oxen
Author: cantabileChaos
Description:
This mod adds oxen as an animal that can be purchased with the big barn upgrade. They haul in one piece of hardwood a day and drop ox tails.

I know it's weird to have them drop a part of their body, but I figured rabbits drop feet so it's no big deal.

Please let me know if there are any issues. I made this mod with the code from my yak mod, so there's a chance I could have accidentally left some things named wrong.

If you are having the issue where Marnie only offers black and brown oxen, it is simply a naming issue I missed when adding the two new colors. The 1.0.3 version should fix this, but it is also a very simply manual fix in the content file if you don't want to go to the trouble of downloading ANOTHER update

Manifest.Name: (BFAV) Oxen
Manifest.Description: Two ox variations and an ox tail.
